main.description: Triaged ingest dispatcher. Calls com.etzhayyim.agent.plan (LangGraph classify→summarise→audit) on the input context, then routes to a skip / fast / thorough branch. Each branch emits an OCEL audit row in vertex_repo_commit. Phase D pilot of ADR-0049 — exposes the planner as a callable BPMN-as-actor.

context.description: Free-form dict the planner inspects (row, snippet, signals).

taskHint.description: Optional hint to narrow the branch decision.

threadId.description: Stable correlation id (BPMN business key, conversation, source row vid).
